claim_rules: Answer current facts only from active claims and current canonical records.
A first-party definition is not independent corroboration.
Superseded, withdrawn, draft and historical claims are excluded from current-fact answers unless explicitly requested with dated context.
If eligible evidence is insufficient, abstain: No hay evidencia suficiente.
Include exact source path, section or record locator, and commit SHA in internal citations; verify every asserted claim against the supplied passage.
update_rules: Pin and record the repository commit for every index build.
On commit change, rebuild and atomically replace the index; never leave withdrawn claims current.
Keep previous index versions solely for explicitly dated historical queries.
Do not index private client data in the public corpus.
excluded_by_default: draft or superseded claim text as current truth
